meanings.note: до ресторана близко = the restaurant is close

examples.trans: The metro is around the corner, the restaurant is close.

examples.trans: I'm in close contact with their informant.

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.

examples.trans: Klavdia Viktorovna, you have visitors! Ta-da!
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

examples.trans: Hello! It's very nice here. Where do I go?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: adult male; declines like a feminine -а noun

examples.trans: A man, my boy, can have more than just a wife. She's my girlfriend.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

examples.trans: She found us at the new place.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that?

examples.trans: Why are you worrying like that? Samsonov is finished, he buried himself.

examples.text: А вы мне тоже айфон подарите?

meanings.en: to come up to, to approach

examples.text: Нам не нужна ваша приставка! Ещё раз подойдёте к моему ребёнку — пожалеете!

meanings.note: очередь подходит = one's turn is coming up

examples.trans: I walk up to the stove. And it dangles right before my eyes!
